name: redis-shared-memory-editor
description: Connect ChatGPT desktop agents to shared Redis Agent Memory and Redis Agent Playbook.

interface.shortDescription: Share memory and read governed Playbook workflows.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP integration for multiple users and their agents to work from the same Redis Agent Memory store and namespace, read source-grounded management state, and load approved Redis Agent Playbook content. Each user keeps service credentials and participant attribution in a private local file.
defaultPrompt: Check the Redis Shared Memory connection status.
